title: State v. Henderson (N.J. 2011)
key_points: Holding: Revised NJ's approach to eyewitness identification based on scientific research; suggestive procedures (such as lack of double-blind administration, poor instructions) are scrutinized.
officer_notes: Scenario: You show a victim a photo array yourself, knowing which photo is the suspect, and say 'Take your time, he's in there.'
Takeaway: Follow the AG eyewitness identification procedures: blind administration, neutral instructions, record confidence.
